profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer - iOS at WHOOP
profile.summary:
I enjoy converting innovative ideas into lines of code, I love coding

I started developing with Visual Basic 6.0 for building software to manipulate a robot (because robots do not move by themselves).

I moved on C# for a variety of consulting roles in Mexico, I worked on the primary enterprise applications on the web. In 2012 after becoming Microsoft Certified Professional Developer (MCPD), I started diversifying my technical skills to cover non-Microsoft technologies, and I adopted Objective-C pretty fast then, on 15th October 2012, I released my first App ever on the App Store (CIE-10-9MC) https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/cie-10-9mc/id566764477?mt=8).

From my point of view, coding and keeping up to date with technology is synonymous with relaxation, and that's why after two years of hard work, I released my first Indie Video Game, Monstrilio!

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Working at WHOOP has been a wonderful experience. When I recently joined the iOS team, I had the task to develop the iOS Core Connectivity and Data Transmission for the WHOOP 3.0 using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). The same framework works for the WHOOP 4.0! I created components like:

- Historical Data. Synchronize the data using the WHOOP BLE protocol, store it into the iPhone, and upload it to the Cloud.
- Send Commands and Process Data using the WHOOP BLE Protocol, process the data and responses using background data tasks and queues by component.
- Managing the Pairing and Bonding process with the device.
- Firmware Update. The process to update the strap's firmware and the Bluetooth Firmware update of the strap using Nordic SDK for iOS.
- Data Sync. Implementing Bluetooth State Restoration and Background Fetch so the app can continuously synchronize data.

I was in charge of creating below UI features that help the company have more retention and growth:
- WHOOP Team Chat. Enables you to message the other members of your team.
- WHOOP AMAs. Professional athletes start a session of Ask Me Anything.
- All-New Navigation Bar. Develop a highly customizable tab bar for the iOS app.
- WHOOP Team Averages. Members can compare performance over customized periods.
- WHOOP Teams. Users can Create Teams, Invite People, and share metrics.
- Performance Profile. New design that displays more statistics.
- Credit Card on Signup flow. Users can enter the credit card to pay/renew the membership
- Activity Live Heart Rate
    Whenever you start an activity using a WHOOP 3.0, you can see your Live Heart Rate. 
- Strap Settings.
    Users can Turn On/Off the HR Broadcast and see the Firmware of the Strap.
    Pair with a WHOOP Strap. Users can initialize the pairing and bonding process.
    Advanced Settings.

I'm grateful to be part of this company and have the support of several people who trusted me and gave me this great opportunity. So excited for all coming new features!

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer (Contractor)
positions.description:
Project developed from scratch:

Milewise℠ by Allstate
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/milewisesm-by-allstate/id1067463541?mt=8

Responsibilities:
•	Understand the technical details and functional requirements of the Milewise App.  
•	Design and develop a SDK to consume RESTFul Web services using JSONModel and NSURLSession, Singleton and Delegation Patterns
•	Design and develop complex algorithms to create stacked bar chart and pie chart
•	Design and develop a complex custom tableview
•	Develop UI using Apple iOS Human Interface Guidelines, Wireframes, Allstate Style Guide and AutoLayout
•	Design and develop base classes to implement "Cards", all views are based on cards and you can reuse it (for example Title Card, Footer Card with Links buttons, Body Card, etc) 
•	Design and Develop persistent data layer using Core Data
•	Develop code with best practice in security, clear cache, encrypt and store data, clear data once session expires.
•	Implemented Site Catalyst 
•	Create many configuration schemas for different environments (Develop, QA, PTEST, Production)
•	Follow and solve defects during tests using HPALM
•	Manage Github repository creating branches, pull requests, releases
•	Partner with delivery team for deploy the app in Apple Store

Project:
Allstate℠ Mobile (v 9.5)
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/allstate-mobile/id364376344?mt=8

Added new functionalities to the master mobile app

Responsibilities:
•	Understand the technical details and functional requirements of the App.  
•	Develop UI following wireframes, functional requirements and Allstate style guide
•	Partner with technical lead to review code and implement best practices
•	Manage source code and create pull request using Github

positions.title: Senior .Net & Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
Project developed using iOS: 
GEFleet Prototype . iOS app is created in order to offer customers fleet location and route to the nearest service center, the project implement push notifications.

Responsibilities: 
•	Analyze requirements of Fleet department
•	Primary architecture used with MVC and Singleton
•	Memory management usign ARC.
•	Implemented many OOP and patterns like MVC, KVO and Singleton.
•	Developed using Xcode 5. Design Core Data structure.
•	Design user interface, UIViewControllers, UITableViewControllers, custom UITableViewCell with Interface Builder.
•	Design custom MapAnnotation. Handling delegates: didSelectAnnotationView, viewForAnnotation.
•	Design all views with auto layout and constrains.

Projects developed using .Net: 
Electronic Accounting. Web site to create Trial balance, Accounts and Activity XML to report to SAT

Customer Risk Rating. Web site developed using MVC 4 pattern, framework 4.5, Entity Framework 5 and was develop with C# to calculate customer risk rating and tracking tool of due date. 

Prototipo Buró de Crédito. Tapes report to Credit Bureau generation automatically in 5 minutes versus one week manually.

Responsibilities: 
•	Analyze requirements.
•	Design database in SQL Server 2012.
•	Design user interface applying GE styles.
•	Create stories and task in JIRA.
•	Versioning source code using VSTF.
•	Implement custom security using Single Sign On and Membership.
•	Implement security by roles and actions in controllers.
•	Develop web site with MVC pattern.
•	Use HP-Application Lifecycle Management for user test.
•	Develop methods to read excel files and validate it.
•	Develop a process to insert information in database from text file and develop configurable validations in data base.
•	Configure and install web site in IIS7.

positions.title: Lead iOS Developer
positions.description:
Project Description: NT Paciente. App to tracking Patient visits with patient diseases and medications. Book appointments and manage dates and the developmental control of patients, contains list of medications and international catalogue of diseases. Use SQLite and can make backups with iCloud. The app can send prescription in PDF format by email.
CBBFactura & CBBHonorarios. App to generate electronic invoices in PDF format, the app can zip invoices by month and send by email. The app use core data.

Responsibilities: 
•	Designing, developing, testing and implementation of app in App Store.
•	Design Core Data structure. Developed with Xcode 4
•	UI and Application design with NIB files programmatically and using Builder interfase.
•	Design user interface, UIViewControllers, UITableViewControllers, custom UITableViewCell with Interface Builder.
•	Implement SDTBarcode to read QRCode and generate QRCode as well.
•	Implement Objective-Zip to compress files and attach to an email.
•	Implemented many OOP and patterns like MVC, KVO and Singleton.
•	Design all views with auto layout and constrains.Performed to complete unit testing, integration testing and regression testing the application.
•	Designing and developing Prescription in PDF format.
•	Design custom html to send an email with Electronic Invoice attached. Design and develop custom alert views.Design custom TabBar.
•	Participated in review meetings and took the initiative to meet the QA testing targets.
Environment:  Objective-C, Xcode, Instruments, UIKit, EventKit, CoreData, SQLite, MessageUI, AddressBook.

Project Description: NovoAprobaciones. It is an application for directors and managers can approve purchase orders, expense Surrenders, events from their mobile devices with this streamline the approval process.
iNovoMuestras. It solves the problem of having to document legal inventory and physician signature when giving originals samplesand have updated inventory.

Responsibilities:  
•	Designing, developing, testing and implementation of app in App Store.
•	Design Core Data structure. Developed with Xcode 4
•	Design user interface, UIViewControllers, UITableViewControllers, custom UITableViewCell with Interface Builder.
•	Implemented many OOP and patterns like MVC, KVO and Singleton.
•	Performed to complete unit testing, integration testing and regression testing the application.
•	Design and develop custom alert views. Design custom TabBar.
•	Participated in review meetings and took the initiative to meet the QA testing targets.

Project Description:  NovoFacturacion. Creates electronic invoices.

Responsibilities:  
•	Analyze requirements.
•	Design database in SQL Server 2012.
•	Create store procedures.
•	Design user interface applying Novo Nordisk styles.
•	Design Custom modals views using bootstrap and JQuery.
•	Versioning source code using VSTF.
•	Implement security by roles and actions in controllers.
•	Design web site using dependency injection.
•	Develop process to import files from SAP and generate electronic invoice using parallel programming.
•	Develop methods to read excel files and validate it.
•	Develop a process to insert information in database from text file and develop configurable validations in data base.
•	Configure and install web site in IIS6.
